name: empty
why: A142 (Q166): the treasury option loses the value that was a second name for another one. Era 31 measured shared and split-on-equal as the same arithmetic - the whole difference over 200 four-seat games was +416, the rounding remainder and nothing else - so three values stood for two behaviours and the lobby row asked a question with no answer. The default is split with an equal rule now, which is what shared always was plus the coin that used to go to nobody; an unknown value reads as split rather than being passed through to a branch that matched neither, which is how a typo used to become a separate treasury. SAVE_VERSION 7 to 8 with a migration mapping shared to split and setting splitRule to equal explicitly, because a save from before era 31 never had one. The option string is hashed state, so every fixture hash moves and no events change.
